qaNotes.prefetchCancellations: Next.js route-prefetch requests with _rsc query strings may report ERR_ABORTED when the test closes a page. They are not document or asset failures and are excluded from unexpected failures.
qaNotes.headingMeasurement: The generic query selected a visually-hidden 1px accessible heading. The rendered page heading was inspected and is not clipped; the hidden element is excluded.
qaNotes.screenshots: 34 full-page screenshots were recaptured after the theme preloader completed and after all image elements decoded.

lightboxCheckNotes: The MediaLightbox listener now supports project-specific data-fancybox groups as well as the original gallery group. Direct browser tests opened the modal, pressed Escape, confirmed the original URL, and observed no page errors.
